hero.title: Growing Forests Together For More Biodiversity In Our Planet

transparency.title: Transparency and Connection for Reforestation
transparency.paragraph1: ApeForest is a platform developed to efficiently and transparently manage reforestation projects. The system connects farmers, companies, and experts in a collaborative environment for monitoring and controlling forest plantings.
transparency.paragraph2: By mapping planting areas, documenting species, and monitoring plant development, we ensure transparency and reliable data for all involved.

forFarmers.title: For Farmers
forFarmers.subtitle: By participating, farmers can increase their visibility, receive local support, and can access new financial resources to expand reforestation practices. Continuous monitoring and transparent documentation value field work and partnerships.

mapAreas.title: Map Your Areas
mapAreas.description: Register and manage your planting locations simply and intuitively on our interactive map.

documentBiodiversity.title: Document Your Biodiversity
documentBiodiversity.description: Record planted species, techniques used, and positive impact on the local ecosystem.

receiveSupport.title: Receive Support
receiveSupport.description: Receive proposals from companies interested in supporting your biodiversity projects.

forCompanies.title: For Companies
forCompanies.subtitle: Companies have access to authentic projects, with reliable data and continuous monitoring, CO2 compensation, and strengthening of sustainable reputation. Direct support to local initiatives generates measurable impact and contributes to a greener and more resilient future.

findPartners.title: Find Partners
findPartners.description: Discover farmers near your region who share the same sustainability values.

evaluateProjects.title: Evaluate Projects
evaluateProjects.description: Analyze biodiversity projects and their potential environmental impact in detail.

makeDifference.title: Make a Difference
makeDifference.description: Establish lasting partnerships and contribute directly to ecosystem restoration.
